note: Region-wide reference numbers for the Southern Waters operational boundary, computed once with server-side count/statistics queries (tools noted in README). Re-run when sources refresh.

barriers.source: SARP_barriers_swf_08042026 (BarrierType=Dam) and All_RoadBarriers_01212019 inside the boundary

attains.source: ATTAINS_Assessment lines (layer 1) intersecting the boundary; 'assessed' excludes Not Assessed units

priority.source: feature counts intersecting the boundary (USFS by bounding box)

secas.note: swfDev.regionBlueprint() over the Oct-2026 boundary using the public Blueprint map tiles (PNG colours → classes) at 1,223 m; classes 4 highest … 0 lower (transparent)

nlcd.source: MRLC NLCD 2021 WMS image of the boundary at ~1105 m, masked by the boundary, colours → classes
